name: tong-reverse
title_zh: 拆解 AI 视频逐帧反推提示词
tagline_zh: 看到惊艳的 AI 视频只能干瞪眼？它把镜头拆成时间轴联系表，反推运镜、物理动态，直接译成 Kling。
tagline_en: Stop staring at stunning AI videos helplessly. It extracts keyframes into a timeline contact sheet, infers camera.
desc_en: Reverse-engineers and decodes prompts from AI videos and images: extracts keyframes, builds a timeline contact sheet, infers camera vectors, physical dynamics, and translates to Kling, Runway, Hailuo, and MJ/FLUX. Use when the user asks 逆向提示词, 反推提示词, 解构视频, 视频提示词推测, 分析视频镜头, reverse prompt, video prompt reverse, deconstruct video, or tong-reverse.
why_zh: 不是猜个大概，而是先建时间轴联系表再逐帧解构，把运镜向量和物理规律拆出来。
why_en: No guesswork: it builds a timeline contact sheet first, then deconstructs camera vectors and dynamics before mapping to each.
limit_zh: 只处理 AI 生成的视频/图像，真人实拍或纯 CG 无提示词可逆。输出是提示词文本，不含生成、调参或对比验证。
limit_en: Only for AI-generated videos/images—no prompt exists in live-action or pure CG. Output is prompt text only; no generation, tuning, or verification.
title_en: Reverse-engineer AI video prompts frame-by-frame into.
